description_en: Retrieves the ranking of public network traffic details at 1-tuple, 2-tuple, and 5-tuple granularities, and supports sorting by metrics such as traffic volume and packet count
description_zh: 调用GetInternetTuple接口，获取公网流量详情数据排名，覆盖一元组、二元组、五元组粒度，支持按流量、包数等指标排序
kebab_example: aliyun nis get-internet-tuple --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tuple-type 1 --begin-time 1684373600099 --end-time 1684373700099 --direction in --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetInternetTuple

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the public network traffic to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的公网流量的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The tuple type to query. Valid values: 
1: 1-tuple. 
2: 2-tuple. 
5: 5-tuple
parameters.help_zh:
查询的元组类型。取值： 
1：表示一元组。 
2：表示二元组。 
5：表示五元组
parameters.name: tuple_type

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询起始时间的毫秒时间戳
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间的毫秒时间戳
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The traffic direction to query. Valid values:

in: inbound traffic to Alibaba Cloud.
out: outbound traffic from Alibaba Cloud
parameters.help_zh:
查询流量方向，取值：

in：入云方向。
out：出云方向
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en: The metric by which to sort the data. Default value: ByteCount, which indicates sorting by traffic volume
parameters.help_zh: 数据排序的指标。默认值：ByteCount，表示按流量排序
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The IP address on the Alibaba Cloud side
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云端IP
parameters.name: cloud_ip

parameters.help_en:
The port on the Alibaba Cloud side. 
This parameter is required only when TupleType is set to 5
parameters.help_zh:
阿里云端端口。 
仅TupleType配置为5时，才需要配置该参数
parameters.name: cloud_port

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the peer.
This parameter is required only when TupleType is set to 2 or 5
parameters.help_zh:
对端IP。
仅TupleType配置为2或5时，才需要配置该参数
parameters.name: other_ip

parameters.help_en:
The port of the peer.
This parameter is required only when TupleType is set to 5
parameters.help_zh:
对端端口。
仅TupleType配置为5时，才需要配置该参数
parameters.name: other_port

parameters.help_en: The instance ID on the Alibaba Cloud side
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云端实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The protocol number. All protocols are supported. 
This parameter is required only when TupleType is set to 5
parameters.help_zh:
协议号。 
支持全部协议， 仅TupleType配置为5时，才需要配置该参数
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en:
The sort order of the traffic data. Valid values: 
desc: descending order. 
asc: ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
流量数据的排序方式。 
desc：从大到小排序。 
asc：从小到大排序
parameters.name: sort

parameters.help_en: The number of top-ranked entries to display. Default value: 10, which indicates that the top 10 entries are displayed. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 展示排序靠前的数据。默认值：10。表示默认展示排序前10的数据。最大值：100
parameters.name: topn

parameters.help_en:
The ISP on the Alibaba Cloud side.
Typically, the value is Alibaba or Alibaba Cloud
parameters.help_zh:
云端运营商。
通常为“阿里巴巴”或“阿里云”
parameters.name: cloud_isp

parameters.help_en:
The ISP of the peer. 
Specify this parameter when you want to view ISP information
parameters.help_zh:
对端运营商。 
查看运营商情况时，请指定此参数
parameters.name: other_isp

parameters.help_en:
The country of the peer.
This parameter is required only when TupleType is set to 2 or 5
parameters.help_zh:
对端国家。
仅TupleType配置为2或5时，才需要配置该参数
parameters.name: other_country

parameters.help_en:
The city of the peer.
This parameter is required only when TupleType is set to 2 or 5
parameters.help_zh:
对端城市。
仅TupleType配置为2或5时，才需要配置该参数
parameters.name: other_city

parameters.help_en: The list of instance IDs for batch filtering
parameters.help_zh: 批量过滤时的实例ID列表
parameters.name: instance_list

parameters.help_en: The list of cloud IP addresses for batch filtering
parameters.help_zh: 批量过滤时的云上IP列表
parameters.name: cloud_ip_list

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the multi-account management feature. Default value: false, which indicates that the feature is not used. 
The multi-account management feature is disabled by default. To use this feature, contact your account manager to apply for permissions
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用多账号管理功能。默认值：false。表示不使用。 
多账号管理功能默认不开放，如需使用，请联系商务经理申请使用权限
parameters.name: use_multi_account

parameters.help_en: The list of IDs of the member accounts
parameters.help_zh: 成员账号ID列表
parameters.name: account_ids

Data.description_en: The ranked list of Internet traffic details
Data.description_zh: 公网流量详情排名列表

items.description_en: The details of a single Internet traffic entry

AccessRegion.description_en:
The access point where traffic enters Alibaba Cloud. 
This parameter is valid only when InstanceId is an Anycast elastic IP address
AccessRegion.description_zh:
流量进入阿里云的接入点。 
仅InstanceId为Anycast弹性公网IP时，该参数有效
AccessRegion.title_en: InstanceId为AnyCastEip时，流量进入阿里云的Pop点。
AccessRegion.title_zh: InstanceId为AnyCastEip时，流量进入阿里云的Pop点。

CloudCity.description_en: The city on the Alibaba Cloud side

CloudCountry.description_en: The country or region on the Alibaba Cloud side

CloudIp.description_en: The IP address on the Alibaba Cloud side

CloudIsp.description_en: The Internet service provider (ISP) on the Alibaba Cloud side

CloudPort.description_en: The port on the Alibaba Cloud side

CloudProduct.description_en: The product code of the instance associated with the Alibaba Cloud IP address
CloudProduct.description_zh: 阿里云侧IP归属的实例对应的产品Code

CloudProvince.description_en: The province on the Alibaba Cloud side

Direction.description_en:
The traffic direction. Valid values:
in: Inbound traffic to Alibaba Cloud. 
out: Outbound traffic from Alibaba Cloud
Direction.description_zh:
流量方向。取值：
in：入云方向。 
out：出云方向

InByteCount.description_en: The inbound traffic volume to Alibaba Cloud. Unit: bytes

InOutOrderCount.description_en: The number of inbound out-of-order packets to Alibaba Cloud
InOutOrderCount.title_en: 入方向乱序包数指标(个)
InOutOrderCount.title_zh: 入方向乱序包数指标(个)

InPacketCount.description_en: The number of inbound traffic packets to Alibaba Cloud

InRetranCount.description_en: The number of inbound retransmitted packets to Alibaba Cloud
InRetranCount.title_en: 入方向重传包数指标(个)
InRetranCount.title_zh: 入方向重传包数指标(个)

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID associated with the Alibaba Cloud IP address

OtherCity.description_en: The peer city. This value is mostly empty when OtherCountry is outside China
OtherCity.description_zh: 对端城市。当OtherCountry为国外时，此值多数为空

OtherProduct.description_en: The product associated with the peer IP address. This value is empty if the IP address is not on Alibaba Cloud
OtherProduct.description_zh: 对端IP归属的产品。如果非云上IP，则为空

OtherProvince.description_en: The peer province. This value is mostly empty when OtherCountry is outside China
OtherProvince.description_zh: 对端省份。当OtherCountry为国外时，此值多数为空

OutByteCount.description_en: The outbound traffic volume from Alibaba Cloud. Unit: bytes

OutOutOrderCount.description_en: The number of outbound out-of-order packets from Alibaba Cloud
OutOutOrderCount.title_en: 出方向乱序包数指标(个)
OutOutOrderCount.title_zh: 出方向乱序包数指标(个)

OutPacketCount.description_en: The number of outbound traffic packets from Alibaba Cloud

OutRetranCount.description_en: The number of outbound retransmitted packets from Alibaba Cloud
OutRetranCount.title_en: 出方向重传包数指标(个)
OutRetranCount.title_zh: 出方向重传包数指标(个)

RetransmitRate.description_en: The retransmission rate of TCP packets

Rtt.description_zh: 往返时延RTT（Round Trip Time）。单位：us
